a framework diagram in three rounded bands. Band one holds 'Problems to Address' (Missing values, Outliers, Conflicting names, Abbreviations) and 'Foundations' ('Arc-Node-Based Multi-layer Network model' with a small star graph and the layer words Car/Pedestrian/Bus/Subway and Motorway/Residential/Primary/Secondary, each closed by a printed ellipsis) joined by a double chevron. Band two holds 'Task 1', 'Task 2', 'Task 3' with their bullets; band three 'Sensitivity Analysis' and 'Safety Contributions'. No legend, no axes, no numbers. The caption prints 'Framwork', the misspelling is the author's, not the text layer's

two rounded containers joined by one dashed arrow. The left container, headed 'edges_all.csv', chains three boxes 'Imputation of missing values' -> 'Outlier Removal' -> 'Handling cluttered road information'; the right container, headed 'MDOT_SHA_Annual_Average_Daily_Traffic_Baltimore.csv', holds one box 'Processing abbreviation information'. Flat boxes with light fills, a thin enclosing border, no legend, axes or numbers. The body prints the twice-stated reference 'The data preprocessing workflow is illustrated in Figure 3.' directly above the artwork

two panels, (a) 'Original road condition' and (b) 'Processed road condition', printed as bold sub-captions under each panel and above the figure caption. Both plot nodes and street segments on longitude-latitude axes with no axis titles; x runs -76.4525 to -76.4490 and y 39.237 to 39.242, and panel (b) prints its y TICKS WITHOUT LABELS, so its vertical scale is unreadable. Legends inside each panel at the upper left: (a) a dashed green swatch reading '[5303705, 431040339]' plus 'Nodes', (b) blue '5303705', red '431040339' and 'Nodes'. Printed on the marks: 'Mixed Road', 'Ross Avenue (5303705)', 'Wells Avenue (431040339)', the node ids '37659797' and '4302893639' (printed adjacent with no separator), and in (b) the slope labels k_1 = 1.135, k_3 = 1.606, k_2 = -0.411 beside the printed inequality |k3-k1| < |k3-k2|

a 1x3 strip of node-link graphs joined by two right arrows and labelled not with letters but with the words 'one layer', 'two layer', 'three layer'. The three graphs nest one, two and three dot-triangles and the colour carries the layering (brown inner, blue intermediate, pale orange outer) but nothing keys those hues. No axes, ticks, legend, colour bar or printed value; every node is an unlabelled dot

a symbolic panel, not a data chart: two stacked rounded boxes headed 'Commuters' and 'Non-commuters' fed by a left-hand brace labelled beta_i, each box holding one printed formula. The commuter line reads J_i,current / J_i,2024 = (7*AADT_i,current - 5*AAWDT_i,current) / (2*J_i,2024); the non-commuter line prints its numerator as (AADT_i,current - AADT_i,current), which is identically zero, so the second coefficient cannot be computed from the formula as printed. No axes, legend or numbers; recorded as 'other' because the exhibit is an equation box rather than a plot

note: 32 measured regions: 22 exhibit rows, all figures, and 10 exclusions. Every region the layout pass returns on this paper except the watermark block is a whole exhibit, so no row needed a fragment-of-other companion: no page in this paper prints two regions under one number, and the figures that do carry two or three panels (Figure 4's (a)/(b), Figure 7's map plus Graph G and G2, Figure 15's (a)/(b), Figure 19's (a)/(b), Figure 21's (a)/(b), Figure 23's (a)/(b)) arrive as one raster each and are recorded as one row with the panel count. The paper prints 25 numbered figures and 5 numbered tables, so 30 exhibits; 22 are measured and 8 are declared gaps rather than given invented bboxes. Three of the gaps are figures on pages the layout pass cannot see at all: p11 and p14 are single full-page inline rasters with no text layer, and they print Figure 9 'Influence Coefficients of Various Stakeholders' (two histograms with the legends 'Commuter' and 'Non-commuter') and Figure 10 'The Roads with the Greatest Impact' (four horizontal-bar panels (a)-(d) for commuter and non-commuter increases and decreases), plus Figure 12 'Histogram of Evaluation Indicators' on p14 (one histogram with an inset and a right axis 'Derivative of Cumulative Sum'). The other five gaps are all five tables, and each one is printed even though none is returned as a region: Table 1 'Notations' on p4 is a 'Symbols | Description' booktabs grid under the 2.2 Notation heading, Tables 2 'Road Names Corresponding to Osmids' and 3 'Example of Outliers' are printed on p5 beside Figure 3, Table 4 'Abbreviations and Full Names' on p6 beside Figure 4, and Table 5 'POI Weight' on the p13 raster. So the table numbering has no hole, and the extractor's silence on p4/p5/p6 is a rule-table detection failure on pages whose text layer is otherwise complete. Eight pages return no region at all: p1 the summary sheet, p2 the contents page, p11, p13, p14 and p24 the page rasters, p25 the reference list and p27 the continuation of the AI-use appendix; of those only p24 carries artwork, a section 10 Memorandum page with one unnumbered greyscale platform photo and no caption, recorded as printed rather than given a bbox the layout pass never returned. Page numbering: the running head reads 'Page N of 25' on every body page while the file has 27 sheets, so the printed count and the physical count differ by two. Caption positions: all 22 figure captions are printed BELOW their artwork and all five table captions ABOVE their grid, with no exception. Places: p15, p16 and p18 took their section from the printed page because the layout pass attaches the heading below the figure; section 6's own heading exists only inside the p13 raster and section 7's only in the body prose, so those rows name the nearest detected subsection (6.2, 7.1, 7.3) instead of a parent the extractor cannot see. Cross-reference and arithmetic defects recorded as printed: p12's prose is cut at 'Figure 10. This suggests ...'; Figure 14's five printed pie percentages sum to 113.0%; two of Figure 16's five floating change labels disagree with its own printed bar values; Figure 19 gives both panels one colour bar labelled 'Inverse Time Cost' when the left panel plots time saved; Figure 21 and Figure 23 colour their cells with no colour bar at all; Figure 22's fits leave one data point outside every curve; Figure 24 prints a numeric x axis at categorical spacing; Figure 4 panel (b) prints y tick marks with no labels; Figure 18's y axis is cut off; Figure 6's second formula prints 'AADT_i,current - AADT_i,current' and so evaluates to zero; and Figure 2's caption prints 'The Framwork'. Text-layer damage: pages 2, 11, 13, 14 and 24 return zero characters, and every caption and citation line on the text-bearing raster pages opens with the same Sinhalese, Arabic-script and danda watermark glyph runs, which is why the caption strings were taken from the printed lines rather than from a leading token.
